purpose: manual import testing only; not bundled
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW complete production sprite sheet of the SAME adorable adult female office-worker character as the reference, including drinking water. Reference is character identity/style only, NOT layout. Preserve chestnut bob hair, peach hairclip, thin round glasses, brown eyes, cream blouse, sage cardigan, navy trousers, socks, peach laptop. Fine warm brown pencil lines and Japanese healing manga watercolor. Full body sitting cross-legged, fixed scale and camera.
OUTPUT LAYOUT: PORTRAIT 1024x1536 PNG, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS x SIX ROWS, 24 equal 256x256 square cells. One figure per cell. Do NOT use six columns or four rows. Every full character, laptop, accessory and effect must stay inside central180x180 of its own cell, at least38px transparent margins. Feet baseline at215px relative to every cell. No overlap between cells. Authentic alpha transparent background, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no grid, no captions, no labels. Identical character identity and proportions all24 frames.
Each horizontal row is one four-frame action in left-to-right order; ALL SIX ROWS REQUIRED:
Row1 WORK: attentive seated typing -> leans forward left hand typing -> determined fast typing with both hands -> relaxes toward first pose. Laptop stays open on lap.
Row2 THINK: looks up -> chin on hand thinking -> tiny glowing idea bulb with raised finger -> pleased smile hand returns. Laptop open.
Row3 TIRED: shoulders slump -> eyes sleepy head lowers -> tiny yawn hand covering mouth -> rubs eye and straightens. Laptop open.
Row4 FINISH: starts closing laptop -> closed laptop rests on lap -> happy arms-up stretch -> lowers arms smiling. Fully contained in cell.
Row5 HEADPHONE MUSIC: mint padded over-ear headphones, closed laptop on lap. Head centered humming -> head tilted left mouth open singing -> centered shoulders bounce -> head tilted right smiling humming. Tiny musical notes.
Row6 DRINK WATER, clearly visible in ALL FOUR BOTTOM CELLS: holds transparent handled mug filled with pale-blue WATER beside CLOSED laptop -> lifts mug rim to lips -> TILTS MUG AT MOUTH, drinking with closed happy eyes -> lowers mug satisfied, mug still visibly held. Four progressive actual water-drinking poses, NOT working, NOT headphones. No headphones anywhere in bottom row. Keep cup, hands, glasses and face anatomically clear. This last row is essential for testing a separate drink action in the app.
A cohesive polished cute sprite atlas with clean empty gutters. No extra characters or decorative panels. Maintain reading order exactly.
